method: All accounting ON/profile OFF. Fresh instances:30 warm +300 timed host updates, one discarded +9 alternating-order pairs. Operator counters not timed. Deterministic recordings use newly fixed-PE builds and common module metadata/full serializer, fixed host+headless runtime clocks; no deleted evidence fields. Trace hash is API evidence, not full CPU/RAM equality.
